w:r.w:t: To create a centralized "Single Source of Truth" console that simplifies access to internal company tools through a secure, single sign-on (SSO) entry point, reducing manual URL management and login fatigue.
All company employees requiring access to internal tools and System Administrators responsible for managing those toolsets.

Employees currently struggle with "tab fatigue" and the inefficiency of managing multiple bookmarks and separate login credentials for various internal applications, leading to productivity loss and security vulnerabilities
Percentage of employees who set Downstream Hub as their primary tool-access portal.
Average time taken to redirect and authenticate a user into a downstream app (Target: $< 200ms$).
Reduction in time spent by IT/Admin on manual onboarding and link distribution.
Self-registration/login, Grid view of applications, Admin CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functionality for app metadata, and secure token hand-off for SSO
Third-party external API integrations (e.g., Slack/Jira), detailed usage analytics per user, and user-specific "pinning" or customization of the grid.
User registers; system checks if the email domain is in the allowed whitelist.
User views a grid of applications assigned specifically to their Business Unit or marked as "Global".
The Hub generates a secure token, appends it to the redirect URL, and the target app authenticates the user automatically.
As a user, I want to register and log in so that I can access my work tools securely.
• Redirects to Grid View on success.
As an Admin, I want to manage a whitelist of domains so that only authorized company emails (e.g., @kpn-corp.com) can register.
• System blocks registration for domains not on the list.
As an Admin, I want to manage Business Units (BU) so I can map users to their respective departments.
• Ability to assign/update a User's BU in the profile.
As a user, I want to see a grid of application list so I can easily find the tool I need.
• Grid displays icon, name, and short
As an admin, I want to manage applications and assign them to specific BUs so that users see relevant tools.
• Fields for Name, Icon, Description, Link, and "Target BU
• Option to assign an app to "All BUs" (Global).
As a user, I want to be automatically logged into target apps so I don't have to re-enter credentials.
• Token passed securely to the target app link.
Links to wireframes, mockups, or Figma.
Internal apps must be updated to accept the Hub's secure token format.
Ensure short-lived token expiration and encryption.
Ensure Super Admins can always access the whitelist to prevent accidental total lockout.
Initial draft: Basic SSO, Grid View, and Admin CRUD.
logic. Updated Risks to include "Domain Lockout."
